item.title: February storms? Severe weather possible Thursday
item.description: Severe weather is expected to hit the Chicago area late Thursday afternoon and evening, with potential strong winds, hail, and an isolated tornado possible.

item.title: The legacy of Citizenship Schools
item.description: In 1957, Esau Jenkins and Septima Clark founded the Citizenship Schools to empower African Americans with education and political power, which eventually became the foundation for the Civil Rights Movement and inspired the creation of Black Bench Chicago.
